categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou SLAC Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and assembly of high-speed metal packaging production equipment, including easy-open can lids and cans. The company has expanded into the production of new energy vehicle battery shells and related precision structural parts. Additional business segments include intelligent inspection equipment, digital printing mini-lines for cans, and photovoltaic power generation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as Draw Wall Ironing (DWI) ultra-thin metal forming for high-speed can production, precision continuous progressive die stamping, high-speed synchronous motion mechanisms, and automated optical inspection. It has developed proprietary six-channel combined lid production systems and bi-directional double-stroke stretching machines, achieving global leading production speeds and precision. The battery shell production lines utilize high-speed automated forming, cleaning, inspection, and packaging processes to ensure high consistency and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international metal packaging manufacturers specializing in two-piece cans and lids, as well as new energy battery manufacturers for electric vehicles and energy storage. The company serves industries such as beverage and food packaging, automotive battery production, and renewable energy sectors. Major end markets are China and overseas regions with growing demand for sustainable packaging and electric vehicle components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Suzhou, Xi'an, Changzhou, and other locations. It has subsidiaries and operations in the United States, Italy, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong, serving global markets. Sales are predominantly domestic (approximately 79%) with significant export activities (about 21%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou SLAC functions mainly as a midstream manufacturer and equipment supplier within the metal packaging and new energy battery supply chains. It produces specialized machinery and precision components used by downstream packaging producers and battery manufacturers. The company also engages in upstream procurement of raw materials like aluminum and steel for battery shells.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-speed automated production equipment and intelligent manufacturing platforms. R&D focuses on enhancing battery shell forming technologies, digital printing for cans, and smart inspection systems. It is developing an integrated SLAC intelligent manufacturing platform for data-driven production management and remote monitoring. Expansion in new energy battery shell production capacity and technology upgrades are key strategic initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized high-speed production equipment, system upgrades, and precision components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by agency sales and participates in industry exhibitions. Revenue also comes from providing technical services, equipment installation, and after-sales support. Additionally, it earns income from photovoltaic power generation and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Suzhou SLAC is a leading domestic manufacturer in the high-speed metal packaging equipment sector, breaking foreign monopolies in easy-open can and lid production machinery. It competes with global players like STOLLE, DRT, BELVAC, and CMB ENGINEERING. The company holds a strong market position in China and is expanding its footprint internationally, especially in new energy battery shell manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.65 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 129 million, down 42.87%. The new energy battery shell segment grew rapidly, accounting for 40% of revenue, up 169.97%. Total assets reached RMB 4.36 billion, showing steady growth. The company is investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a workforce of over 1,800 employees including 484 technical staff.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou SLAC emphasizes its technological leadership in ultra-high-speed, high-precision metal forming equipment and integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its proprietary six-channel combined lid system and bi-directional double-stroke stretching machine offer superior speed and precision unmatched globally. The company’s digital printing mini-line enables cost-effective, high-quality personalized can printing, supporting C2M business models. Its battery shell production lines deliver high consistency, efficiency, and cost advantages, supporting customers’ innovation and scale-up needs.
